leo: Heads-up: I'm drafting a compact Optimize Toolkit FAQ entry: 'Micro-batching patterns for low-latency quantized inference'. Wants: one short decision table paragraph, two tiny SDK snippets (Go + Python), and a short migration blurb about kv-prefetch default flips. Looking for reviewers.

anya: Nice. Can you keep snippets under 10 lines each? Also let's avoid hard-coded model names in the code blocks.

leo: Yep, placeholders only. Will include a one-line perf note: "benchmark short vs long sequences".

kiran: I can author the Go snippet and sanity-check our Go client's API shape. Will also verify we don't reference the deprecated `batch_size_hint` param.

leo: Draft Go snippet (kiran to test):

```go
// pseudocode - redwood-go-client
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
req := redwood.GenerationRequest{
  Model: "<model-name>",
  MaxTokens: 48,
  Batching: redwood.MicroBatch{MaxBatchTokens: 256},
  KVPrefetch: false, // reduce peak RAM with quant kernels
}
resp, _ := client.Generate(req)
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

kiran: Will try this against a q4 build and report back. Quick note: for Go clients we prefer explicit `KVPrefetch: false` rather than omitting the field.

leo: Great. Python snippet idea (yang will review): simple sync example showing switch to `kv_prefetch=True` for long-batched workloads.

yang: Draft Python snippet:

```py
# pseudocode - redwood python
from redwood import Client, GenerationRequest
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
req = GenerationRequest(model="<model-name>", max_tokens=64, batching={"type":"micro","max_batch_tokens":512}, kv_prefetch=False)
resp = c.generate(req)
print(resp.text)
```

yang: I'll run quick smoke locally. Note: samplegen needs a metadata blob if we add these snippets to examples; docs-bot will remind us.

docs-bot: Reminder: Add samplegen metadata (opt/microbatch-quant) and run code-block-lint. See CONTRIBUTING.md#samplegen.

anya: Also check anchor for quant profiles. I think the stable anchor is `#quantization-guidance` not `#profiles-recommendations` (we changed this last quarter). I'll confirm and update links.

leo: Good catch. Migration blurb draft: "Older Toolkit examples assumed kv-prefetch on; with quantized kernels this can increase RAM. Benchmark kv_prefetch on representative data and prefer explicit setting in snippets." Keep it short.

kiran: Perf note from my local quick run: micro-batching (batch tokens 256) reduced per-token cost on high-QPS workloads but increased 95th latency for single-user short requests. Adding a one-line recommendation: "single-request streaming for 1-3 concurrent short sessions; micro-batch when concurrency or throughput is the objective."

leo: Plan: I'll open a WIP PR and tag @kiran @anya @yang for review. Will include samplegen stub and link to quant doc anchor as confirmed by Anya. Aiming for review by mid-week. :sparkles:
